fixture: 14 UTC days,70000 distinct high-churn one-sample-per-ID series, rawUUID TimeSeries v11 with daily SAMPLES, recent TTL off
intervention: Rewrite specialized avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(metric[window])) to explicit SQL per-ID avg on SAMPLES plus stage label from original TAGS. No day-cover/sidecar table created; no changes to source C++ or original table schema relative to control.

comparison.output_parity: Full native timestamp/labels/Float64 for finite gauge synthetic fixture, 38 or1 output point per query, no missing results

findings: 14d broad same-runner SQL without cover improved native p50 395.89->254.865ms (1.553x) and CPU786.50->405.29ms; scanned rows same210000 and selected marks same298. This supports query execution/column projection rather than fewer physical marks as source of gain.
3d broad TAGS SQL was slower by ~81%, 1d broad slower by~153%, so a global SQL rewrite is rejected. Stage1d SQL 8.8% faster on this fixture.

Full-native vs daycover SQL 14d previously 2.97x in another runner and direct tag SQL vs cover SQL 14d sidecar ~4% slower on another runner; do not multiply or subtract cross-runner ratios as a causal estimator.
Steady full-sample write cost absent; a no-sidecar plan would avoid sidecar write cost, but only for admitted query subset and exact native semantics.
falsifiers: Different expression trees, arrayJoin/explicit aggregation and native PromQL toVectorGrid mean no general semantic equivalence for NaNs, staleness, repeated sample timestamps, histogram/rate, build/job regex or multiple evaluation steps was proved.
One-sample-per-series gauge test only; require R01 multi-sample/staggered 15/60/300s and Jenkins high churn, full numerical parity, time boundaries, duplicate updates and index/ACL/tenancy.
No source-pinned C++ integration or production O2/jemalloc throughput/p99; not a stock native planner improvement.
next_action: Collect query CPU processor attribution for native vs TAGS SQL under same runner, then repeat exact multi-sample R01 3d with snapshots/merges and 1/4/8 concurrent clients. Only if robust, consider guarded native SQL planner specialization, not global rewrite.
